chapters.1.title: The Letter · First Glimpse of the Caged Cipher
chapters.1.description: In late autumn 1941, Shen Mo sits alone in the accounting room, opening the old booklet left by his teacher—starting from a mini 4×4 grid, rows, columns, boxes, cages, notes, mnemonics, and the Rule of Ten unfold again in memory as his teacher's lessons resurface one by one. The letter on the rainy night, the trail of the old bookshop, the outer wall of the Library... At the end of the prologue, the first closed loop.
chapters.2.title: The Rooms · Beneath the Library
chapters.2.description: In November 1941, the Tokkō's raids on old books and printed matter intensify. Shen Mo steps into the B1 corridor beneath the Library, learning the Star Balance Law and difference deduction as he follows the traces left by his father. Ito—who knew his father and serves in the Tokkō—appears on this path for the first time.
chapters.3.title: The Doors · The Library's Depths
chapters.3.description: At the end of November 1941, Shen Mo follows the signposts left by his father through the Library's underground from B1 to B3—mastering row blocks, column blocks, and box blocks in turn. Ito's practice book in the B2 chamber, the letter at the B3 entrance where his father stopped... behind the deepest door, an unfinished puzzle lies quietly in an iron box.
chapters.4.title: The Cord · 94 Dongyuhang Road
chapters.4.description: In December 1941, an old brass key engraved with the number 4 opens 94 Dongyuhang Road—the note system and hidden singles grow deeper layer by layer. Room 402, Room 403, Room 404, Pan Hanyu's note, the Lu Lu Tong Teahouse, the backup radio—each layer draws closer to the truth left behind by his mother.
chapters.5.title: The Current · The Transmitter
chapters.5.description: December 7, 1941, in the stone chamber B3 beneath the Library. Before the transmitter, three sets of messages are sent at three-second intervals—frequency tuning, antenna calibration, the closing in of the direction-finding van, Yamada's file—until, as the last message goes out, news of Pearl Harbor spreads through the streets.
chapters.6.title: The Web · Shanghai
chapters.6.description: December 8, 1941. The thunderous news of the Pearl Harbor attack sweeps across all of Shanghai. The accounting room, the bookstore, Bridge No. 4, the old Lu Lu Tong site, the transmitter... Yamada's raids, traces of Shen Shi'an, until the rendezvous with Pan Hanyu. My father's path, Ito's path, and my own path have finally aligned.
chapters.7.title: The Storeroom · Finale
chapters.7.description: After Pearl Harbor, the whole city is placed under martial law. The final engravings in the western suburb warehouse, the envelope entrusted by his father at 72 Dsiswei Road, the final address at the old bookstore on Avenue Joffre, the handwritten letter by the Suzhou Creek, the steamship ticket to Vladivostok, the farewell at the accounting room... Shen Mo steps onto the gangplank at the dock, leaving Shanghai. Every door, every path, every trace, every game—all closed in perfect completion.
